title: Cocaine wholesale prices in the United States, in US$ per kilogram
source: UNODC, World Drug Report 2026, Statistical Annex, table 8.3 "Price time series in Western Europe and the United States", sheet Cocaine_US, row "Average, in US$"
source_note: UNODC calculations based on UNODC Annual Report Questionnaire (ARQ) data.
coverage: 1990-2021. UNODC has not published a US wholesale figure after 2021; the 2026 annex ends at the same year as the 2025 annex.
caveats: A single national average per year. UNODC's own country table gives the 2018 US range as $4,000-$45,000/kg, so the spread behind this line is enormous.
Not adjusted for purity. The annex carries a purity-adjusted series for retail only, not for wholesale.
Member-state self-report via the ARQ, so year-to-year jumps can be reporting artefacts rather than market moves (e.g. the 2011 spike to $40,800).
